title: GTC Image Verification Report
description: Output of the GTC Image Verifier tool. Reports only what a file declares (C2PA, XMP/EXIF) plus clearly separated, non-authoritative heuristic flags. Never asserts AI-generation as fact in the absence of declared provenance.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes analyzed. Can be cross-referenced against a GTC content manifest's content_hash.

c2pa.description: Result of scanning for and, if a validator is loaded, verifying a C2PA manifest.

status.description: absent: no JUMBF/C2PA box found. present: found and validated. present_unvalidated: found but no validator library available client-side. invalid: found but signature/chain failed validation.

digital_source_type.description: The raw digitalSourceType URI's final path segment, as declared in the C2PA manifest, verbatim — not restricted to GTC's four tracked buckets. See classification.value for GTC's mapped bucket, if any.

validated.description: true/false if a validation pass ran; null if no validator was available to run one.

raw.description: Raw manifest object or error string, for the collapsible 'Raw C2PA data' UI section. Omit or truncate for report exports intended for sharing.

metadata.description: XMP/EXIF findings. This is a metadata read, not a forensic analysis.

software.description: xmp:CreatorTool or tiff:Software field, if present.

generative_ai_marker.description: True if a known generative-AI tool name or phrase was found in the XMP block. A weak, string-matching signal only.

raw_xmp_excerpt.description: First ~2000 chars of the raw XMP packet, for transparency.

capture_timestamp.description: Normalized from EXIF's 'YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS' format where possible; not guaranteed strict ISO 8601 if the source tag was malformed.

exif_library_loaded.description: True if exif-js (window.EXIF) was available at scan time. False means only the raw XMP regex fallback ran — no camera/GPS/timestamp data.

classification.description: The single declared-or-undeclared classification GTC surfaces prominently. Never derived from heuristics alone.

source.description: Where the classification value came from. c2pa_declared_unmapped: a C2PA manifest declared a real digitalSourceType outside GTC's four tracked buckets — see c2pa.digital_source_type for the raw value.

confidence.description: declared: read from a validated C2PA assertion. weak: inferred from a metadata string match only. none: no basis; value is 'Undeclared'.

heuristics.description: Non-authoritative pattern flags. Additive context only — must never change `classification` above.

weight.description: info: background context. notable: reserved for future stronger heuristics; currently unused to avoid overclaiming.

limitations.description: Fixed, always-shown statement of what this check does not and cannot establish.
